title: ScalpelMod
body:
# ScalpelMod

**ScalpelMod** adds professional tools with questionable applications.

This is not a weapon mod first. It is a utility-focused Minecraft Forge mod about tools being pushed beyond their intended purpose. Everything is designed to feel clean, functional, and connected to a larger system.

## Community Project

ScalpelMod is a community-updated mod. Contributions are welcome from anyone with the skill to help improve the project.

You can contribute if you can work on things like:

- code
- textures
- models
- recipes
- balancing
- systems
- documentation
- ideas that fit the mod’s direction

Even texture editing alone can be useful if it matches the mod’s visual style and quality standards.

## Current Features

- **Scalpel**
  - A fast, low-damage melee tool
  - Built around precision rather than brute force
  - Includes the custom **Surgical Combo** combat mechanic
  - Consecutive hits on the same target increase damage temporarily
  - Resets when switching targets, stopping too long, or dropping the combo

## Design Direction

ScalpelMod is built around a serious, professional tone:

- tools first, weapons second
- clean utility-focused design
- systems that connect together
- no random standalone content
- vanilla-friendly presentation

Future content may include more tools, blocks, mobs, structures, and interconnected systems based around labs, facilities, job sites, and professional environments.

## Requirements

- Minecraft Forge
- Minecraft 1.20.1

## Status

ScalpelMod is early in development. More features and systems are planned.
